description.en-US: Tired of sitting, tired of reading? Click a button, jump on your bed, and have the article read aloud to you. You can choose from many available male and female voices. You can also set the pitch of the voice and the reading speed. Supports PDF. Supports EPUB (via the excellent EPUBReader extension). Read Aloud is a Firefox extension that uses text-to-speech technology to convert webpage text to audio. It works on a variety of websites, including news sites, blogs, fan fiction, publications, textbooks, school and class websites, online universities and course materials. Read Aloud is aimed at users who prefer to listen to content instead of reading, people with dyslexia or other learning disabilities, children learning to read, or simply to provide users with alternative way to consume web content. Read Aloud allows you to select from a variety of text-to-speech voices, including those provided natively by the browser, as well as by text-to-speech cloud service providers such as Google Wavenet, Amazon Polly, IBM Watson, and Microsoft. Some of the cloud-based voices may require additional in-app purchase to enable. Recent developments in machine learning and artificial intelligence has enabled very high-quality speech synthesis. Google Wavenet, Amazon Polly voices, for example, use bleeding edge technology to provide life-like synthetic speech that is close to that of human speech. Read Aloud allows you to use your own Google Cloud Platform and Amazon Web Services account to enable these voices. To use Read Aloud, simply navigate to the web page you want to read, then click the Read Aloud icon on the Firefox menu. In addition, the shortcut keys ALT-P, ALT-O, ALT-Comma, and ALT-Period can be used to Play/Pause, Stop, Rewind, and Forward, respectively. You may select the text you want to read before activating the extension. Right clicking on the selected text will provide you with yet another context-menu option to activate Read Aloud. To change the voice, reading speed, pitch, or enable text highlighting, go to the Options page either by right clicking on the Read Aloud icon and choose Options, or by clicking the Gear button on the extension popup (you'll need to stop playback to see the Gear button). Privacy Policy Personal information If you use one of the Premium Voices, you'll be asked to sign in to your Google account and grant Read Aloud access to your basic user profile, which includes name and email address. We require this information for usage tracking, since the Premium Voices requires making a purchase when usage exceeds the monthly free tier. If you don't use the Premium Voices, you don't need to sign in, and no information is collected. Browsing history We do not track the user's browsing history. We realize the importance of privacy, so we make sure our extensions require only the minimum set of browser permissions to operate. In particular, during installation, it does not ask for the "Read your browsing history" or the "Read and change all your data on the websites you visit" permissions, both of which could be used to track the user's browsing history. Text converted to speech When you select one of the standard text-to-speech voices, the speech synthesis occurs locally on your computer and is never sent to the internet. And neither the input text nor the synthesized speech are saved or stored on your computer. When you select one of the premium text-to-speech voices, the input text is sent to our cloud server for synthesis. The server may use your anonymized IP address and User-Agent data for purpose of analytics, abuse management, and service improvement. The server may cache the input text, as well as the synthesized speech, for short amounts of time as part of its normal operation; it does not save them to any type of permanent storage. Geolocation If you select a voice that is synthesized on our server, your anonymized IP address may be used for geolocation for analytics purposes. Issue reporting and contact forms If you use the in-app report-issue function or use the contact form on our support website, your comments and information may be kept in our support database for a maximum of 6 months. Analytics The extensions use Firefox Addons Store's built-in analytics. Firefox will collect basic extension usage data, including when the extension is installed, invoked, and uninstalled. The extension may also use its own counters to analyze usage patterns. This information is anonymized and do not present privacy concerns.

description.de:
AliExpress liefert keine brauchbare Rechnung mehr. AliVAT löst das für Selbstständige und kleine Unternehmen, die ihre Einkäufe verbuchen müssen.

WAS ES TUT
• Fügt auf jeder Bestellseite neben den AliExpress-Buttons einen Button "Rechnung herunterladen" ein.
• Kästchen in der Bestellübersicht: Bestellungen anhaken, eine ZIP mit PDFs exportieren.
• Massenexport nach Datum aus dem Symbolleisten-Popup, praktisch für ein Umsatzsteuer-Quartal.
• Gutschriften für erstattete Positionen mit Datum und Grund; Teilerstattungen werden markiert.
• Rechnungen auf Deutsch, Englisch und Niederländisch.

WAS AUF DER RECHNUNG STEHT
Lieferant (die AliExpress-Gesellschaft) und der Shop, deine Rechnungsdaten mit USt-IdNr. und Handelsregisternummer, Lieferadresse, Bestellnummer und Daten, Zahlungsart, jede Position mit SKU, Menge, Einzelpreis und Gesamt, Zwischensumme, Versand, Coupons, Zoll wo AliExpress ihn berechnet, Gesamtbetrag, MwSt.-Betrag mit Satz und Nettobetrag. Die Beträge entsprechen der Abrechnung von AliExpress. Wo AliExpress nur "inkl. MwSt." angibt, wird die MwSt. zum Regelsatz berechnet und so gekennzeichnet.

DATENSCHUTZ
Alles läuft lokal. AliVAT liest dieselben Bestelldaten, die die AliExpress-Bestellseite lädt, mit deinem eigenen Login, und erzeugt die PDFs im Browser. Keine Analyse, kein Server, nichts wird hochgeladen.

ENTWICKLER UNTERSTÜTZEN
AliVAT ist kostenlos. In den Einstellungen gibt es "Entwickler unterstützen" (standardmäßig an): Beim Öffnen von Warenkorb oder Kasse setzt AliVAT im Hintergrund den Referral-Cookie des Entwicklers, sodass eine kleine Provision in die Entwicklung fließt, ohne Kosten für dich. Es wird nichts an AliExpress-Seiten geändert; abschaltbar.

HINWEIS
Die PDF ist ein Dokument, das du selbst aus deinen Bestelldaten erzeugst, keine Rechnung von AliExpress; das steht auf jeder Seite. Ob sie deinen Buchhaltungsregeln genügt, klärst du mit deiner Steuerberatung. Nicht mit AliExpress oder Alibaba verbunden.
description.en-US:
AliExpress no longer gives you a usable invoice. AliVAT fixes that for freelancers and small businesses that need to book their purchases.

WHAT IT DOES
• Adds a "Download invoice" button next to AliExpress' own buttons on every order page.
• Checkboxes on the orders overview: tick orders, export one ZIP of PDFs.
• Bulk export by date range from the toolbar popup, handy for a VAT quarter.
• Credit notes for refunded lines, with refund date and reason; partial refunds are marked.
• English, Dutch and German invoices.

WHAT IS ON THE INVOICE
Supplier (the AliExpress entity) and the store that sold the item, your billing details with VAT and Chamber of Commerce number, ship-to address, order reference and dates, payment method, every line with SKU, quantity, unit price and total, subtotal, shipping, coupons, customs duty where AliExpress charges it, total, VAT amount with rate, and net amount. Numbers match what AliExpress charged. Where AliExpress only says "VAT included", the VAT is calculated at your country's standard rate and labelled as such.

PRIVACY
Everything runs locally. AliVAT reads the same order data the AliExpress order page loads, with your own login, and generates the PDFs in your browser. No analytics, no server, nothing uploaded. Settings stay in Firefox's extension storage.

SUPPORT THE DEVELOPER
AliVAT is free. In the settings there is a "Support the developer" option (on by default): when you open your AliExpress cart or checkout, AliVAT applies the developer's referral cookie in the background so a small commission goes to development at no cost to you. It never changes anything on AliExpress pages and can be switched off.

NOTE
The PDF is a document you generate from your own order data, not an invoice issued by AliExpress; it says so on every page. Whether it satisfies your local bookkeeping rules is between you and your accountant. Not affiliated with AliExpress or Alibaba.

Habeas — reclaim your own data, in your own session Many services hold data that is yours — receipts, invoices, card, bank or investment movements — behind walls you can't automate (Cloudflare, Akamai…), with neither an API nor an export. Habeas gives it back to you. Unlike server-side scraping, Habeas runs inside your real browser, in your already signed-in session. Because of that:
  • It never fights anti-bot systems: it inherits your valid session.
  • It never stores your passwords. You log in yourself; the token lives only in memory and is cleared when you close the browser.
  • You solve MFA/OTP live, exactly as you always do.
It's the opposite of how server-side account aggregators operate. Your archive, made visual Everything you recover lands in your Archive: a clear view of your documents, laid out in a source → account tree, with cards grouped by month or category, amounts, and status. Search, filter by account, and open any saved document. The toolbar popup is a fast launcher into your Archive. You decide where your archive lives By default, your archive is stored locally in this browser. With one click you can move it to the cloud to reach it from several devices — we recommend Dropbox, and it also supports Google Drive, WebDAV, S3, or a local folder. You can also send specific documents to destinations: download, local folder, Dropbox, Drive, WebDAV, S3, or an HTTP endpoint. Nothing leaves your browser until you choose a destination. Sources are data, not code Sources are declarative definitions (no remotely-hosted code, honoring MV3's rules). There are audited first-party sources and a growing community catalog covering supermarkets, retail, cards and banking, energy, telecom, and more. The current catalog is at https://habeas.dev/sources.html Missing a service? Record mode watches the site's own API as you browse and drafts the source for you — no coding — and you can share it with the community. Privacy and control, by design
  • Local-first and open source (AGPL-3.0): you can audit exactly what it does.
  • Domain-bound trust boundary: a source's captured session can only ever be replayed to its own service; crossing domains requires an explicit allow-list and a consent screen.
  • Integrations on your terms: a website can propose a data flow, but nothing runs until you approve it — and only back to that same site. Revocable anytime.
Your right, your data Habeas rests on your right to data portability (GDPR, Art. 20) and the principle of habeas data: it's your own data, in your own session, through free software you run yourself. Habeas is not a PSD2-regulated actor (it initiates no payments). Each site's terms of service may restrict automated access; complying with them is your responsibility. No telemetry · no accounts · no stored passwords.
description.es-ES: Habeas — recupera tus propios datos, en tu propia sesión Muchos servicios guardan datos que son tuyos —tickets, facturas, movimientos de tarjeta, banco o inversiones— tras muros que no puedes automatizar (Cloudflare, Akamai…) y sin ofrecerte ni una API ni una exportación. Habeas te los devuelve. A diferencia del scraping en servidores, Habeas se ejecuta dentro de tu navegador real, en tu sesión ya iniciada. Por eso: • No pelea contra los sistemas anti-bot: hereda tu sesión válida. • Nunca guarda tus contraseñas. Tú inicias sesión; el token vive solo en memoria y se borra al cerrar el navegador. • Tú resuelves el MFA/OTP en directo, como siempre. Es lo contrario de cómo operan los agregadores tipo Plaid o Tink. Tu archivo, visual Todo lo que recuperas aterriza en tu Archivo: una vista clara de tus documentos, organizados en un árbol por fuente y cuenta, con tarjetas agrupadas por mes o categoría, importes y estado. Busca, filtra por cuenta y abre cualquier documento guardado. El popup de la barra es un lanzador rápido a tu Archivo. Tú decides dónde vive tu archivo Por defecto, tu archivo se guarda localmente en este navegador. Con un clic puedes moverlo a la nube para acceder desde varios dispositivos —recomendamos Dropbox, y también admite Google Drive, WebDAV, S3 o una carpeta local. Además, puedes enviar documentos concretos a destinos: descarga, carpeta local, Dropbox, Drive, WebDAV, S3 o un endpoint HTTP. Nada sale de tu navegador hasta que tú eliges un destino. Fuentes que son datos, no código Las fuentes son definiciones declarativas (no código remoto, cumpliendo las reglas de MV3). Hay fuentes auditadas de primera parte y un catálogo comunitario creciente que cubre supermercados, comercio, tarjetas y banca, energía, telecomunicaciones y más. ¿Falta un servicio? El modo grabación observa la propia API del sitio mientras navegas y redacta la fuente por ti —sin escribir código— y puedes compartirla con la comunidad. Privacidad y control, por diseño • Local-first y código abierto (AGPL-3.0): puedes auditar exactamente qué hace. • Frontera de confianza por dominio: la sesión capturada de una fuente solo puede reenviarse a su propio servicio; cruzar de dominio exige una lista explícita y una pantalla de consentimiento. • Integraciones con tu permiso: una web puede proponer un flujo de datos, pero nada se ejecuta hasta que lo apruebas —y solo de vuelta a esa misma web. Revocable cuando quieras. Tu derecho, tus datos Habeas se apoya en tu derecho de portabilidad (RGPD, art. 20) y en el principio de habeas data: son tus propios datos, en tu propia sesión, mediante software libre que tú ejecutas. Habeas no es un actor regulado por PSD2 (no inicia pagos). Los términos de servicio de cada sitio pueden restringir el acceso automatizado; su cumplimiento es responsabilidad tuya. Sin telemetría · sin cuentas · sin contraseñas guardadas.

Sieh dir YouTube-Videos in deiner Sprache mit natürlicher Echtzeit-Synchronisation an, ohne Untertitel lesen zu müssen. FyDub übersetzt den Ton von YouTube-Videos während der Wiedergabe und verwendet dabei natürliche Stimmen, die mit dem Originalinhalt synchronisiert sind. Kein Pausieren, kein Lesen und keine komplizierten Schritte: Öffne einfach ein Video, klicke auf „Video übersetzen“ und FyDub erstellt sofort synchronisierten, gedubbten Ton passend zum Originalinhalt. ⸻ ✦ HAUPTFUNKTIONEN 🔄 KI-gestützte Synchronisation und Übersetzung — der gedubbte Ton passt seine Geschwindigkeit dynamisch an, um in Echtzeit mit den Untertiteln synchron zu bleiben. 🎙️ Dubbing mit natürlichen Stimmen 🌍 Aus jeder Sprache übersetzen — höre Videos in bis zu 27 Sprachen mit natürlichen männlichen oder weiblichen Stimmen 🔊 Volle Kontrolle — passe die Lautstärke des Originalvideos und des gedubbten Tons unabhängig voneinander an 🎛️ Steuerung im Seitenpanel — ändere Sprache, Stimme und Einstellungen, ohne das Video zu verlassen 🔍 Suchübersetzung — entdecke Videos in jeder Sprache und höre sie automatisch in deiner eigenen 🌐 Oberfläche in 27 Sprachen — nutze die Erweiterung bequem in der Sprache, die du verstehst ⸻ ✦ SO FUNKTIONIERT DIE AUDIOÜBERSETZUNG
  1. Öffne ein YouTube-Video in einer anderen Sprache als deiner eigenen.
  2. Klicke auf die Schaltfläche „Video übersetzen“ unter dem Player.
  3. Das Video beginnt, sich in Echtzeit mit deiner Sprache zu synchronisieren und zu übersetzen.
  4. Im Seitenpanel kannst du Sprache, Stimmen und die Lautstärke des Originalvideos ändern, deine kostenlose Nutzung ansehen oder auf Premium upgraden, um unbegrenzte Übersetzungen zu erhalten.
✅ https://youtu.be/9TBZBp8caB4 ✦ SUCHÜBERSETZUNG — SO FUNKTIONIERT ES Finde mehr globale Inhalte: Gib deine Suche in deiner Sprache ein und FyDub übersetzt sie automatisch, um dir Videos in anderen Sprachen anzuzeigen.
  1. Suche ganz normal in deiner Sprache.
  2. Sobald die Ergebnisse angezeigt werden, erscheint auch die Schaltfläche „Suche übersetzen“.
  3. Klicke auf die Schaltfläche „Suche übersetzen“.
  4. Wähle die Sprache aus, in die du deine Suche übersetzen möchtest.
  5. Du siehst Ergebnisse in der ausgewählten Sprache. Jedes Video zeigt:
  6. Originaltitel
  7. Titel in deine Sprache übersetzt
  8. Wähle das gewünschte Video aus. Sobald das Video geöffnet ist, klicke auf die Schaltfläche „Video übersetzen“. Die Audioübersetzung in deine Sprache startet automatisch.
⸻ ✦ KOSTENLOSER UND PREMIUM-PLAN Kostenloser Plan: Minuten pro Monat + Minuten pro Tag Kein Konto und keine Kreditkarte erforderlich Premium: Unbegrenzte Übersetzungen, alle Sprachen, alle Stimmen und das volle Echtzeit-Dubbing-Erlebnis ⸻ ✦ DATENSCHUTZ UND TRANSPARENZ FyDub verarbeitet die Audioübersetzung über sichere externe Server. Es werden nur die öffentliche YouTube-Video-ID und die ausgewählte Sprache verwendet, um den Ton zu generieren. Wir verwenden eine anonyme Gerätekennung, um Nutzungsgrenzen zu verwalten und den Zugriff wiederherzustellen — keine persönlichen Daten, kein Konto erforderlich und kein Tracking über Websites hinweg. Lies die vollständige Datenschutzerklärung: https://extension.fydub.com/privacy.html

description.en-US:
❗ Test the extension by using speech color changer and don't forget to leave a review and comment! The extension's code is open source and viewable on GitHub. If you don't care about privacy just set the provider to Google and you'll have the best overall experience (equivalent to the Speech Recognition API used in Google Chrome). Android support has not been tested. ⭐ Key Features:
  • Works out of the box if your first language is English, one option away for other languages.
  • Extension uses WASM, no external client or app needed.
  • Privacy first, vosk (local) is the default model.
  • Decent Web Speech API Support through Polyfill (obviously)
  • Customizable Keybind for Speech to Text anywhere, alongside the polyfill
  • Many Local Models to choose from (Vosk/Whisper/Nvidia)
  • Realtime Streaming/Word-to-Word Continuous Speech like Chrome (Vosk/Nvidia/AssemblyAI/Google)
  • Local & Offline Transcription Support (Vosk/Nvidia/Whisper..see info part)
  • Cloud/Server Transcription Support
  • Extensive Per-Site and Default Customization Options
  • Icon Status and Notification toasts to guide you. Toasts aren't enabled by default
  • Exporting and Importing Settings
  • Auto Language Detection based on data from site's and some speech models.
  • Many languages to choose from when using their respected country code (support depends on the engine used).
📝 Info:
  • On first install/every update, this extension will open the options page, the default model language is English but this is easily changeable. This extension allows per-site customization and a multitude of different models to decipher language. It also has a key-bind for Speech to Text (default: Alt + A). Keep in mind that this is not a complete solution and the API doesn't have full support but it's pretty close. Speech Detection is nearly as instantaneous (depending on the model), it is now has Google Chrome's Cloud API. The extension icon color/indicator changes depending on the process so pin it to your menu to verify the extension is working as intended. A red mic/error icon does not necessarily mean your mic isn't working but rather the speech may have been cancelled by user input, missing cloud API key, or that it is unintelligible (usually its the latter).
  • Some obscure websites with non-standard text input fields may not work properly with the keybind (ex: https://onlinenotepad.org/notepad), this is not a complete limitation as some may think BUT rather an annoyance that will take me several hours to make it works consistently across most sites without text repetition, deletion, replacement or other dumb input glitches. 99% of websites will work just fine right now. That's pretty much the last barrier in this extension that likely won't be fixed or atleast by me due to time constraints.
  • Make sure you are using the correct mic and speak loud, slow, and clear otherwise your voice may not be detected or unintelligible. Change the default model to the cloud or slightly larger or different local ones if you experience problems with voice recognition (this may impair performance). You can also try enabling "boost microphone gain" if you are a soft speaker. If you are constantly processing audio over 1-2 mins, disable the ultimatum processing timeout feature in the settings.
  • If you're using Duolingo or similar and are trying to do the speaking practice of the language that you are learning, it is recommended to set the language in the extension to the one you are learning (navigate to the site -> click extension icon -> set language then click "save for site"). This isn't required but it will significantly improve the accuracy of your speech since the model now knows the exact language you are trying to speak. (This isn't exactly necessary for every site, one example is google translate which tells us the exact language that is being used through the input box's data so auto-detect works fine). Look at the images for more help.
  • If you do care about privacy and want the overall fastest and most accurate local model you'll need to use Nvidia Parakeet. Be aware that these models are >1GB. Though, I haven't tested larger Vosk Models yet so those may be good too. Nvidia Parakeet will never have model-based site overrides.
  • You can also use my Speech Recognition Polyfill Userscript as an alternative for simplicity/accuracy, or cross-browser compatibility purposes, but the extension is overall better and isn't that complicated to use anyways. The userscript only supports Google's APIs.
  • Android is not officially supported, it is only made available for those who want to test it.
  • Userscript-based Chrome Extension
❗ Caveats:
  • 8GB of RAM is a minimum requirement for local models since they could easily take up a decent chuck when utilizing larger models. DO NOT make an issue about RAM usage unless there is a memory leak.
  • A modern CPU/GPU is recommended, mainly for local models. Emphasis on the GPU part.
  • A decent internet connection (50mbps UP/DOWN) is recommended, but especially before using offline mode since the model needs to cache itself first.
  • Not being illiterate and reading the FAQ before making a review.
  • Understanding that implementing the Web Speech API perfectly isn't feasible and that this extension has more support than anything else available.
  • Understanding that anything can break and that I have no obligation to continuously update the extension.
  • Understanding that you need a beefy PC if you want the best performance out of local models. DO NOT complain that the model you want to use is slow. Vosk is the default for a reason.
Even though the model runs locally, the extension re-downloads it either when idle or after closing the tab/opening a new one that utilizes the extension (for memory preservation purposes). This is ultimately better than packaging the large models within the extension for the time being and for most models, the download speed will be near instant for the general population. We also have an option in settings to keep the default model cached without re-downloading every time. Its locally offline as long as you use the caching option and don't close the browser or switch between models. We cannot make the models stay downloaded after closing the browser due to Firefox's limitations. Apart from locally you can use the cloud based models which is much less hardware intensive. RAM is not an issue until you use local models. The extension will take ~1GB of ram on default settings and up to ~7GB if you use some of the biggest models (you don't need to use the biggest models lol). I've implemented extremely decent memory management to compensate.

developer_comments.en-US: tl;dr as of December 17, 2025, Microsoft has blocked our method of being able to get free text-to-speech -- Hey folks, I'm working on trying to figure out the best way to get the word across — but for now, here's the state of things: The long and short of it is that as of now, in order to be able to emulate the Edge web browser and request (free) text-to-speech from Microsoft servers, part of the emulation includes adding special headers to the websocket request. But browser environments do not allow for custom websocket headers. I have been spinning my wheels for the past couple of days trying out work-arounds and seeing if I could manage to get something to work — but I don't see a way around this restriction. This has taken out — overnight — my edge-tts browser extension, Obsidian plugin, and web interface https://tts.best/ For now, you can still get edge-tts through formats like the original Python package rany2/edge-tts and I managed to make it work for the free edge-tts mobile app on Android and iOS To anyone interested, the line in the Python code that is basically "missing" from my attempts to fix the various packages and services, it's here: https://github.com/rany2/edge-tts/blob/master/src/edge_tts/communicate.py#L441

description.en-US:
SnapInvoice is an offline invoice maker that runs entirely in the browser. Open it from the toolbar, click any text on the invoice and type. No account, no server, and no data ever leaves the user's device. Just click through and have your invoice printed. You can use it for personal and professional purposes... whatever it is you need it for. Features
  • Click-to-edit invoice editing, with logo, signature and bank details saved for reuse
  • Six invoice designs: three free, three unlocked with PRO
  • Automatic totals, VAT and discounts, with the total written out in words
  • 51 currencies, including NGN, USD, EUR and GHS
  • Export as PNG image or print-ready A4 PDF
  • WhatsApp sharing enabled- strictly user-initiated
  • Magic tools: turn a plain sentence into priced line items, or draft a payment reminder
  • All fonts bundled locally; the add-on makes no network requests
Data and permissions The extension requests no permissions, contains no content scripts and no background scripts, and declares data_collection_permissions required ["none"] in the manifest. Invoice data is stored only in the browser's localStorage. Monetization The free version is a complete, functional invoice tool. An optional one-time PRO upgrade (three additional templates and watermark removal) is purchased on an external site (Selar). This is disclosed here and the payment checkbox has been ticked.

description.en-US:
TMetric is a time tracking app that helps streamlining your growing business for higher profits, satisfied clients and happy teams. Convenient start and stop timers from your browser provide great control over time intervals and calculations on how much time is spent on certain projects, clients and tasks in an instant. Integrations TMetric integrates with 50+ popular services including Asana, Jira, Notion, Trello, which lets you measure progress and activity in any tool you use. You can see the full list here https://tmetric.com/integrations/ Project management With TMetric, set project budgets, track development costs, and see your earnings. Making clear reports in TMetric, you have a choice to get insights into your projects or focus on details. Zero time waste. Optimal expense tracking. Team management Measure effectiveness and activity level of your team, monitor workflow and distribute workload. TMetric syncs your teams’ work and improves collaboration with clients. Budgeting and invoicing With the flexible billing system, you can set rates both for the project and for the hour, invoice clients and get paid promptly. The financial reports help you get instant insight into your financial performance Transparent PTO calculations Easy paid time off (PTO) tracking, clear time off policies for employees, quick leave approvals and accurate attendance management. No more emails, paperwork and manual calculations. Complete the following simple steps to integrate time tracking with your app.
  1. Sign up and log in to TMetric.
  2. Install the extension.
  3. Enable the integration with your app.
  4. Log in to your app. If it's open, refresh the page.
